full_judgment: 2. The plaintiff claimed partition or schedule 'kha' out of schedule 'Ka' land of the plaint. The schedule 'Ka' land of R.S, khatian No. 245 belonged in raiyati right Ensanuddin and others under Nabab others, and the same was auction solid in pursuant to a rent decree for arrears of accept and the plaintiff's father, Mujahar Ali, purchased the entire raiyat on 23.1.1936 and the sale was duly confirmed on 27.2.1936. Mujahar Ali obtained the sale certificate and delivery of possession. He died leaving a widow, Bakful, a son, Khoka and a daughter, Hakimannessa (the plaintiff). Khoka died leaving behind Bakful, Hakimannessa and paternal uncles, Atahar and Hatem (defendants Nos. 2 and 3 Bakful sold some of the lands out of her share to Atahar and Hatem. The R.S. Khatian No. 245 was recorded in the name of plaintiff's father. The plaintiff came to know that defendants Nos. 2 and 3 sold a portion of the suit land out of their share to defendant No. 1. Finding joint possession inconvenient the plaintiff demanded partition but was refused by the defendants on 15.2.62.
